title: Date Night Jigsaw
description: When a mysterious jigsaw arrives on Catherine and Bruce's doorstep for their date night, the picture slowly reveals something disturbingly familiar.
excerpt: Catherine and Bruce settle in for a quiet date night when an anonymous jigsaw appears on their doorstep. As they piece together the image, familiar objects begin to reveal a horrifying message.
author: from-a-storyteller
